newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bills mixed.
newsitem.headline: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bills mixed.

text.p: Yields on one-month to one-year Saudi treasury bills were mixed on Tuesday, bankers said.
The yield on 28-days bills maturing on March 22 and on 91-day bills maturing on May 22 was steady at 5.3585 percent and at 5.4836 percent respectively.
The yield on 182-day bills maturing on August 21 fell to 5.5444 percent from 5.6097 percent and the yield on 364-day bills maturing on February 19, 1998 fell to 5.6302 percent from 5.7994 percent.
The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) bills, worth a total two billion riyals, were priced at 99.58496, 98.63281, 97.27344 and 94.52344.
SAMA did not offer the weekly treasury bills last week because of a four-day official Moslem holiday.
One-month interbank deposits were at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent and one year were quoted at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent.
